impact_assessment.assessment: The W3 model factory constructed every A3 run as TemporalCNN1D(dropout=0.0) before training. The generic serialized config incorrectly retained its default dropout value 0.3. Therefore the committed A3 checkpoints and validation metrics describe the intended no-Dropout model, while the config.dropout metadata field is wrong. This erratum corrects interpretation only and does not recompute or overwrite a historical metric.
